title: 5.8 Prices
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Ask How much is it? and understand prices from one to ten dollars on known food, drinks and a bag.
grammar_function: How much is it? It is one dollar. The juice is four dollars.
prerequisite: 2.6-2.7 numbers; 2.3 bag; 5.1-5.3 fruit, food and drinks.
speaking_outcome: Ask How much is it? and say a price.
